_comment: Mutation testing for src/logic.js. Run it with `npm run mutation`.
Why: logic.js holds how an expense splits between members and what each member owes. Line coverage shows those lines ran; a surviving
mutant shows no test depended on them.
Stryker is NOT a dependency: `npm run mutation` installs it with --no-save, so
package.json and the lockfile stay untouched. It runs in Stryker's sandbox
(a copy under .stryker-tmp/), so it is safe beside uncommitted work.
`break` is a RATCHET set just under the measured score. Raise it when the score
rises; never lower it. Not part of preflight.sh: run it by hand after changing
Measured 90.75% on 2026-10-27 (1383 killed incl. 9 timeouts / 131 survived / 10 no-coverage of 1524); break set to 90.
